cohort: The cohort included 56,014 pregnant women at a gestational age of 28 weeks or more, whose data was collected from the Maternity Near Miss Surveillance System.
finding: The incidence of PPH in Zhejiang Province was 3.60%, and significant independent risk factors included multiple births, vaginal delivery, macrosomia, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and a lower educational level.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as a significant independent risk factor for PPH (OR 3.00; 95% CI 2.62-3.42; P < 0.01).
followup_time: within 24 h of delivery (for PPH definition)
birth_weight: N/A (macrosomia was an exposure, but not a general birth weight criteria for the whole cohort)
